proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the iron’s label/ratings plate (brand, model, wattage).
Send a short video: fill with water, switch on, show heating indicator (if any), then continuous steam for 30–60 seconds.
Show the soleplate/steam holes close-up (no heavy scale) and confirm no dripping during the test.
Send a photo of the plug and a full view of the cord (no cuts/kinks).
Show warranty/receipt or written guarantee terms (even a screenshot).
